species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–28 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 52°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–30 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northwest wind at 12 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
